title: Mixing: Wings Over America by Wings | 1976
content:
Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tom Walsh

Wings continued mixing the live album Wings Over America on 12 November 1976.

On this day, the eighth of 13 mixing sessions, the songs ‘You Gave Me The Answer’, ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’, and ‘Go Now’ were worked on.

‘You Gave Me The Answer’ and ‘Go Now’ had been recorded on 23 June 1976 at the Forum in Inglewood. ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’ was from the 22 May 1976 show at the Boston Garden in Boston.
